children: Rezolute, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 results as a clinical-stage company with no product revenue: Revenue was $0 and the company posted a net loss of $77.6M, or $(0.75) diluted EPS, compared with a net loss of $74.4M and $(0.98) diluted EPS in fiscal 2025.
Revenue was $0 for FY 2026 and FY 2025 (clinical-stage company with no product revenues).
Net income: Net loss $77.6M for FY 2026 vs. net loss $74.4M for FY 2025 (loss widened by $3.2M, ≈4% larger YoY).
Diluted earnings per share: $(0.75) per share for FY 2026 vs. $(0.98) per share for FY 2025.
Clinical development: Advancing ersodetug in two Phase 3 programs — sunRIZE (congenital HI) and upLIFT (tumor HI) — with a potential BLA submission targeted for mid-2027.
Regulatory engagement: The FDA is reviewing sunRIZE data after the trial missed its primary endpoint; the agency has acknowledged trial challenges and is evaluating the totality of data.

Trial milestones: sunRIZE topline results were completed and did not meet the primary endpoint; upLIFT was modified to a single-arm study (about 16 patients) with topline expected before the end of 2026.
Operations and costs: R&D spending declined about 13% driven by lower manufacturing and PPQ activity, while G&A rose 59% due to commercial planning and increased compensation.
Liquidity: Capital raised through equity financings is expected to support planned trials and operations for at least 12 months from the fiscal year-end.
